# Your Fave Photobooth

> Premium Photo Experience company serving Maryland, Washington DC and Virginia. Weddings, corporate events, brand activations, birthdays and anniversaries.

## Photo Experiences & pricing
- Portrait Booth, investment starting at $1,500, 3 hours. Studio-quality session led by a live professional photographer; premium backdrop, stanchions & photo rug; digital gallery; unlimited prints. Guest favorite.
- Classic DSLR Photobooth, investment starting at $650, full day. Unlimited photos, live gallery, instant sharing, custom template design. Most popular.

## Why clients choose us
- Thoughtful consultation, detailed planning, early arrival and seamless execution.
- Custom backdrops, overlays and templates matched to your brand or wedding vision.
- Hosts trained to guide guests; prints and digital photos delivered during the event.
